content: Twitch channel-point-driven overlay pattern: EventSub WebSocket/webhook fires a redemption event in real time; overlay app (OBS Browser Source) listens and renders alert/animation, or drives OBS itself via the built-in obs-websocket server (Tools > WebSocket Server Settings) to trigger scene changes. Common implementations map a specific reward to a specific deterministic visual action (alert pop-up, scene switch, in-world event) rather than free-text/arbitrary effects, and moderate/rate-limit reward creation to prevent spam.
